description: TiSystem supports low-voltage electrical-network design, including circuit diagrams, device selection, cable sizing and protection checks. BTicino offers a browser-based TiSystem 8 and an installable TiSystem 7, with example projects and manuals. The provider is BTicino. Coverage: The software addresses user-specified civil, service and industrial installations. The page references Italian electrical requirements; project suitability elsewhere requires a separate standards check. Access: The public product page was read. Registration, login and download prompts were not followed. Licence and cost: Manuals and software access routes require a MyBTicino account. The public page does not establish full licence conditions, source-code rights or charges. Limitations: The provider’s claims of compliance do not replace project-specific engineering checks. Version-specific features and model inputs require review. For simulation it supports electrical-network sizing and engineering verification. Related resources: No existing catalogue record explicitly covers TiSystem.
